hook.text: Airbnb charges guests a service fee and hosts a commission. Both sides pay for the connection.

buildup.text: Marketplace commissions typically range from 10-30%. The platform adds value by matching supply to demand.

discovery.text: Uber takes 25% of every ride. The driver does the work; Uber provides the match and the payment.

twist.text: Once a marketplace dominates, sellers can't leave. Amazon sellers accept 15% fees because that's where buyers are.

climax.text: Two-sided marketplace fees are powerful because leaving means losing access to the other side.

punchline.text: Connect buyers and sellers, then tax every transaction. Simple power.

quiz.question: Why can dominant marketplaces charge high commissions?
